P. Thuminad]] in his directorial debut and is produced by Shashidhar Shetty Baroda, Ravi Rai Kalasa, and [[Raj B. Shetty]] under Lighter Buddha Films. It stars Shaneel Gautham, [[J. P. Thuminad]], Sandhya Arakere, [[Prakash Thuminad]], Deepak Rai Panaje, Mime Ramdas and Raj B. Shetty.{{Cite web |last=M. V. |first=Vivek |date=2025-07-28 |title='Su From So': How an unheralded Kannada film broke marketing norms to set box office records |url=https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/movies/su-from-so-kannada-movie-box-office-records-raj-b-shetty-jp-thuminad-break-marketing-norms/article69862850.ece |website=[[The Hindu]]}} Set in the coastal village of Marlur linked to [[Someshwar Beach|Someshwara]], the story follows Ashoka, a carefree young man whose innocent crush spirals into rumours of possession by a ghost named Sulochana, upending village life through a cascade of comedic supernatural events. The film was released theatrically on 25 July 2025. Upon release, it received overwhelmingly positive reviews and became a commercial success. It also became [[List of highest-grossing Kannada films|the seventh highest-grossing Kannada film of all time]] and [[List of Kannada films of 2025|the second highest-grossing Kannada film of the year]].{{cite web | title=Su from So OTT release: When and where to watch the Kannada horror comedy | work=The Economic Times | date=6 September 2025 | footfalls in [[Kannada cinema]] after ''[[Raajakumara (film)|Raajakumara]]'' (2017),https://www.moneycontrol.com/entertainment/su-from-so-ott-release-when-and-where-to-watch-the-kannada-horror-comedy-film-photo-gallery-13482907-2.html ''[[KGF (film series)|KGF Series]]'' (2018–2022), ''[[Kantara (film)|Kantara]]'' (2022) and ''[[777 Charlie]]'' (2022).{{Cite web | title=Ajay Devgn In Talks With 'Su From So' Director JP Thuminad For a Horror-Comedy | |access-date=3 January 2026 |date=3 January 2026}} It was remade into [[Marathi language|Marathi]] as ''[[Tumbadchi Manjula]]'' (2026).{{cite web |last1=Sharadhaa |first1=A. |title=Raj B Shetty's Su From So remade in Marathi as Tumbadchi Manjula |url=https://www.cinemaexpress.com/kannada/news/2026/May/24/raj-b-shettys-su-from-so-to-be-remade-in-marathi-as-tumbadchi-manjula |website=Cinema Express |access-date=25 May 2026 |date=24 May 2026}} == Plot == Ashoka, a young painter in the village Maruluru, develops a crush on a woman. One night, while returning from a party, a drunk Ashoka peeps through the window of her bathroom. To escape, he acts like he is possessed by a ghost. From the next day, he finds himself at the center of unwanted attention. In an attempt to get rid of the "ghost", a timid priest is called, and Ashoka plays along, saying he is possessed by 'Kalpana', the ghost from the popular horror movie ''[[Kalpana (2012 film)|Kalpana]]'' (which itself is a remake of the 2011 [[Tamil language|Tamil]] film ''[[Kanchana (2011 film)|Kanchana]]''). In the chaos, people mishear it as Sulochana. A famous priest, Karunakar Guruji, is called to get rid of the "spirit", and he then concludes that Ashoka is indeed possessed by a spirit named 'Sulochana', hailing from the neighbouring town 'Someshwara'. Bizarre rituals are performed to exorcise the spirit from Ashoka's body in vain, as he inadvertently causes people to think that he is still possessed. As a last resort, the villagers go to Someshwara to find Sulochana, where they find a woman, Bhanu, whose mother, Sulochana, died not long ago. She is coincidentally the first prospective bride whom Ravi "Anna", a popular man in the village, had visited and rejected years ago, and, as fate has it, both are still unmarried. Bhanu then regularly visits Ashoka's village to talk to her mother via Ashoka, to persuade her to leave his body, and he gradually learns of Bhanu's struggles, her uncle's harassment and his sexual advances towards her. To put an end to all of this, Ashoka dresses up to resemble Sulochana, goes to Someshwara, and beats up Bhanu's uncle. A fight then ensues between the villages, and Ravi Anna and the other villagers decide to end it by bringing Bhanu to Maruluru permanently. Ashoka, still pretending to be possessed, says that Bhanu must marry one of the men of Maruluru, and Ravi Anna, who developed feelings towards Bhanu during this time, agrees. Ashoka then returns to normal, bringing an end to the pretentious act, while Bhanu and Ravi marry. ==Cast== {{Cast listing| * Shaneel Gautham as Ravi "Anna" * [[J. P. Thuminad]] as Ashoka * Sandhya Arakere as Bhaanu * [[Prakash Thuminad]] as Chandra * Deepak Rai Panaje as Sathisha * Mime Ramdas as Yadhu * [[Raj B. Shetty]] as Karunakar "Guruji"{{Cite web | title=Was Raj B Shetty's Su from So's role as Karunakar guruji more matchmaker than exorcist? | url=https://www.ottplay.com/news/was-raj-b-shettys-su-from-sos-role-as-karunakar-guruji-more-matchmaker-than-exorcist/a29d3bb636929 | access-date=2025-08-29 | website=www.ottplay.com}} * Pushparaj Bolar as Bhaava * Mamtha Shetty as Mala, Chandra’s wife * Manish Shetty as Guruji's assistant * Prakruthi Amin as Appi, Ashoka's sister * Tanishka Shetty as Chaithra, Ashoka’s love-interest * Shiva Alike as Daamu * Arjun Kaje as Prasada, Ashoka’s friend * Utsav Vamanjoor as Chethu, Ashoka’s friend * Vijayalakshmi B Rai as Sulochana, Bhaanu’s dead mother }} == Production == The film marks the directorial debut of JP Thuminad, known for his appearance in the Kannada film ''[[Sapta Saagaradaache Ello: Side B|Sapta Sagaradaache Ello – Side B.]]'' He played Deepak, the husband of Priya, acted by [[Rukmini Vasanth]] in the film''.'' He has worked as an assistant and behind the scenes in several Kannada films. Also known for his works in tulu theatre, he has also acted in several [[Tulu language|tulu language film]] such as ''Meera, Kattemar, and Katapadi Katappa.''{{Cite web |last=Sharadhaa |first=A. |date=2025-06-05 |title=Raj B Shetty Interview: The industry needs new faces and voices |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/entertainment/kannada/2025/Jun/25/raj-b-shetty-interview-the-industry-needs-new-faces-and-voices |access-date=2025-08-25 |website=The New Indian Express }}{{Cite web |title=Raj B Shetty-JP Thuminad's Su from So Malayalam version gets a release date |url=https://www.ottplay.com/news/raj-b-shetty-jp-thuminads-su-from-so-malayalam-version-gets-a-release-date/f688d500b8494 |access-date=2025-08-25 |website=OTTPlay }} The film has been produced by Shashidhar Shetty Baroda, Ravi Rai Kalasa and Raj B Shetty under the banner of Lighter Buddha Films. Set in the coastal Mangaluru–Udupi region of Karnataka, the title refers to ''Sulochana from Someshwar'' with its initialism ''Su from So''. The music was composed by Sumedh K.{{Cite web |last=Ponnappa |first=Sanjay |date=2025-07-15 |title=Su From So trailer: Raj B Shetty's supernatural comedy promises a laugh riot |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/movies/regional-cinema/story/su-from-so-trailer-released-supernatural-comedy-mangaluru-village-2756213-2025-07-15 |access-date=2025-08-25 |website=India Today }} The background score was composed by Sandeep Thulasidas, who is an associate of [[Sushin Shyam]] in several films. ==Soundtrack== The film's songs were composed by Sumedh K, an independent musician, debuted in the mainstream cinema with this film's soundtrack.{{Cite web|title=Su from So (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack) |access-date=2025-10-10|website=Deezer|date=25 August 2025 |url= https://www.deezer.com/en/album/810492001}} The background score was composed by Sandeep Thulasidas. The film began with a single premiere in [[Mangaluru]], followed by [[Shivamogga]] and [[Mysuru]], quickly snowballed into 28 preview shows across Karnataka before its theatrical release on 25 July.{{Cite web |last=Sharadhaa |first=A. |date=2025-07-28 |title=Su From So rewrites box office rules |url=https://www.cinemaexpress.com/kannada/news/2025/Jul/28/su-from-so-rewrites-box-office-rules |access-date=2025-07-28 |website=[[Cinema Express]]}} The film's Malayalam dubbed version was released on 1 August 2025. ===Distribution=== The film was distributed in North India by [[AA Films]]. Its Malayalam dubbed version was released in [[Kerala]] by [[Dulquer Salmaan]]'s Wayfarer Films and Mythri Movie Makers for Telugu release. The film was distributed internationally by Phars Films.{{Cite web |last=Sharadhaa |first=A. |date=2025-07-28 |title=Su From So rewrites box office rules |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/entertainment/kannada/2025/Jul/28/kannadanews2025jul28su-from-so-rewrites-box-office-rules |access-date=2025-07-28 |website=[[The New Indian Express]]}} === Home media === The post-theatrical streaming rights were acquired by [[JioHotstar]]. The film began streaming there from 9 September 2025. [[Colors Kannada]] has acquired the satellite rights for the film. The film premiered in [[Colors Kannada]] on 12 October 2025.{{cite web | title=Su from So OTT Release Date: Raj B Shetty's Comedy Drama Streams on JioHotstar Sept 9 | Raj B Shetty's Blockbuster Su from So to Premiere on JioHotstar – Date & Details | when and Where to Watch Su from So Movie Online | JioHotstar OTT Release Update | Su from So Digital Release: Raj B Shetty's Comedy Drama Arrives on OTT Sept 9 | JP Tuminad's Su from So OTT Release Confirmed – Streaming Details Inside – FilmiBeat | date=13 September 2025 | url=https://www.filmibeat.com/top-listing/su-from-so-ott-release-date-confirmed-raj-b-shettys-blockbuster-comedy-drama-streams-on-jiohotstar-from-september-9-3-5495.html }}{{cite web | title='Su from So' OTT release: Find where to watch the comedy-drama online | work=The Times of India | date=27 August 2025 | url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/kannada/movies/news/su-from-so-ott-release-find-where-to-watch-the-comedy-drama-online/articleshow/123407220.cms }} ==Reception== ===Critical reception=== ''Su From So'' received highly positive reviews from critics. Vivek M. V. of ''[[The Hindu]]'' wrote, "‘Su From So’, directed by debutant JP Thuminad and backed by actor-director [[Raj B. Shetty|Raj B Shetty]], is helped by witty performances as it becomes a rare horror comedy that seamlessly blends thrills with a pertinent message".{{Cite web |last=M. V. |first=Vivek |date=2025-07-25 |title='Su From So' movie review: JP Thuminad delivers a refreshing and hilarious horror comedy |url=https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/movies/su-from-so-movie-review-raj-b-shetty-jp-thuminad-refreshing-hilarious-comedy-kannada-movie/article69854341.ece |website=[[The Hindu]]}} Susmita Sameera of ''[[The Times of India]]'' gave 4/5 and wrote "'Su from So' emerges as a refreshing entertainer that blends laughter, heartfelt moments, gentle romance, and a powerful message — wrapped in a wholesome package for the entire family to enjoy."{{Cite web |last=Sameera |first=Susmita |date=2025-07-25 |title=Overloaded with Laughs, Grounded in Meaning |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/kannada/movie-reviews/su-from-so-overloaded-with-laughs-grounded-in-meaning/movie-review/122900644.cms |access-date=2025-07-28 |website=[[The Times of India]]}} A.
